meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Zillow: consent bar, app badges and nav ad slot, plus recommendations, listing badge and footer controls (home page only)
meta.notes:
Checked LIVE on 2026-11-13 on the zillow.com home page only (iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA), logged out, headless Chrome; counts were taken on the saved rendered DOM. Search results, map, and home detail pages could not be captured (Zillow bot checks and the machine's network failed), so rules for those pages are limited to one cited rule.

LIVE counts: `aside.dg-consent-banner` 1 on both (present but `display: none` in the capture), App Store and Google Play badge links 1 each on both, `[data-testid="home-recs-carousel"]` 1 on the phone (its cards were still loading skeletons) and 0 on desktop, `[data-testid="property-card-badge"]` 3 on the phone, `footer.site-footer` 1 on both.

SOURCE only: `li:has(> p[class*="NavAdContainer"])` comes from a filter proposed in AdGuard AdguardFilters issue 200335 (the list item holding a permanently spinning ad slot in the search results). It was not seen live, and its fixture (`desktop-nav-ad.html`) is hand-written. The Zillow classes are styled-components hashes (`StyledBox-c11n-…`) and are never used; all other rules use `data-testid`, `aria-label` and element names.

NOT verified: search and listing pages (Zestimate cards, photo galleries, save buttons), the sign-in prompt that Zillow shows on some pages, logged-in state.
